[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[The SAVE Act’s strangest gift: it is making Democrats talk like noncitizen voting is real](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY C. J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **SAVE Act would require proof of citizenship to vote:** The proposed SAVE America Act would mandate documentary proof of citizenship when registering to vote and pair that requirement with a photo ID standard for federal elections.
* **Debate centers on whether verification is necessary:** Critics argue the measure could burden eligible voters, while supporters say verifying citizenship is a basic safeguard for elections limited to U.S. citizens.
* **Examples cited of noncitizen voting incidents:** Reviews of recent elections have identified small numbers of noncitizens casting ballots—such as 35 cases found in Iowa’s 2024 election—highlighting the ongoing debate over how frequently the issue occurs and whether stronger safeguards are needed.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **

**[The Capitol flagpole is not a friendship bracelet](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY C. J. GARBO | COMMENTARY | MARCH 13** _Colorado’s State Capitol is not a festival stage. It is a civic altar of sorts, the place where law is made, rights are protected, and citizens who disagree about nearly everything are still supposed to recognize one another as equals under the same authority. That is why a flagpole on Capitol grounds is never “just symbolic.” It is government speech, rendered in cloth and wind._
**[Before he was a congressional candidate, Manny Rutinel was calling animal agriculture “horrific”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | MARCH 11** _Manny Rutinel spent the better part of six years calling animal agriculture a “horrific, exploitive industry.” Rutinel entered the legislature through an appointment in 2023 when Rep. Dafna Michaelson Jenet resigned from the District 32 seat. Less than two years later, he was filing paperwork for Congress._
**[Tracking the Iran conflict: A Colorado veteran’s daily sitrep from day 10 onward](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY KENNESAW | COMMENTARY | MARCH 11** _As a USAF ELINT veteran, I have always anchored my compass in Bible truth and the Founders’ original intent on liberty first, peace through strength, and no endless entanglements. Today, they are coming for the transgender community in Kansas. In a sweeping and cruel move, the state has moved to invalidate the driver’s licenses and birth certificates of over 1,000 residents. The government is attempting to erase their existence from public life. History teaches us a chilling lesson: authoritarianism never stops at one group. When the state begins nullifying the rights of one marginalized community, it creates the blueprint to come for the rest of us. At Able Dems, we know that the rights of people with disabilities are inextricably linked to the rights of the LGBTQ+ community. Many of our own members live at the intersection of these identities. If they can invalidate a birth certificate today, they can slash disability protections or roll back the ADA tomorrow. We MUST fight back now before there is nobody left to fight for us. We are recruiting and supporting candidates who will stand as a firewall against this hate. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

name: David Hogg
subject: We need to elect leaders who have a real plan to address the affordability crisis
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
That gap between what politicians say and what families are actually going through is the affordability crisis.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260313-1&t=1&akid=3243%2E587540%2E5rGh2b)
Peter,
Just a couple weeks ago, Donald Trump stood at the State of the Union and bragged that the economy is “roaring” and that our nation is “bigger, better, richer, and stronger than ever.” Now, this week, after spending millions of dollars everyday on his war with Iran he has managed to not only spend more of our tax dollars but to also spike gas prices by 10%.
**The idea that our economy is doing great couldn’t be further from the truth.** Rent is up. Health care is up. Groceries are up. Now gas is up. Paychecks are not keeping pace. And too many leaders are still acting like a good stock market headline is the same thing as a family being able to afford the basics. Most people still say the economic state of the country is poor, and people’s confidence in the economy improving has dropped significantly since last year.
That gap between what politicians say and what families are actually going through _is_ the affordability crisis, Peter.
That’s why at Leaders We Deserve, we are building a new generation of leaders who tell the truth, listen to their communities, and fight for working people with real plans to lower costs.
When Zohran Mamdani launched his campaign last year, he showed what real leadership looks like. He listened to people, built his agenda around what they actually need, and put forward a serious plan to tackle the affordability crisis. That’s why we were so proud to support him in his primary for NYC mayor.
And we’re seeing it again as a new wave of Democratic leaders steps up in this year’s races. When candidates are honest about what families are going through and have an actual plan to lower costs, people pay attention and turn out to vote. That’s how we’ve been winning, and it’s how we keep building momentum from here and beyond.
**[If you want more candidates who will take on corporate greed and fight for working families, can you chip in $5 today to help us elect the next wave of Democrats who actually have a plan to tackle the affordability crisis?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260313_1_affordability.GzktYW&refcode=em20260313-3243&amount=5&t=2&akid=3243%2E587540%2E5rGh2b)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260313_1_affordability.GzktYW&amount=5&refcode=em20260313-3243&t=21&akid=3243%2E587540%2E5rGh2b)**
Thank you,
David Hogg

body:
The Movement for Freedom is joining the global Nuestra America Convoy.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/02650aff78a8/tockcw1cwy-294?e=81ab29c4d2)

| | | | | | Peter,
---
| |
We are joining the global Nuestra America Convoy, embarking on a critical mission to deliver essential medical and humanitarian aid to the people of Cuba.
**The humanitarian situation has been gravely exacerbated by recent policy decisions originating from the United States.** Specifically, following President Trump’s authorized threat to significantly increase tariffs on countries supplying oil to Cuba, the economic stability of the island has deteriorated rapidly. This aggressive economic maneuver has instilled a profound fear of retaliation among nations that previously maintained trade relations with Cuba.
The direct result of this foreign policy pressure is a drastic worsening of daily life for millions of Cubans. They are now facing widespread and increased energy blackouts, which cripple daily commerce and domestic life. **Furthermore, vital food supply chains have been severely disrupted, leading to widespread food insecurity and chronic shortages. This has escalated the general economic hardship and material shortages to a crisis level.**
Our position remains unequivocal: regardless of the specific political leadership currently in power in Cuba, we cannot, in good conscience, remain passive or silent. It is morally imperative that we act when vulnerable populations are being deliberately subjected to severe economic hardship and deprivation. This suffering is not the result of natural disaster, but is a direct consequence of political pressure stemming from the United States government's continued pursuit of a regime change. The convoy is a testament to the principle that humanitarian concerns must transcend political disagreements and economic warfare.
****

Follow our time in Cuba on IG, TikTok, Facebook, and UpScrolled @Mvmt4freedom!

clean_body: The Movement for Freedom is joining the global Nuestra America Convoy. | | | | | | | | | | | | | Peter, | | We are joining the global Nuestra America Convoy, embarking on a critical mission to deliver essential medical and humanitarian aid to the people of Cuba. The humanitarian situation has been gravely exacerbated by recent policy decisions originating from the United States. Specifically, following President Trump’s authorized threat to significantly increase tariffs on countries supplying oil to Cuba, the economic stability of the island has deteriorated rapidly. This aggressive economic maneuver has instilled a profound fear of retaliation among nations that previously maintained trade relations with Cuba. The direct result of this foreign policy pressure is a drastic worsening of daily life for millions of Cubans. They are now facing widespread and increased energy blackouts, which cripple daily commerce and domestic life. Furthermore, vital food supply chains have been severely disrupted, leading to widespread food insecurity and chronic shortages. This has escalated the general economic hardship and material shortages to a crisis level. Our position remains unequivocal: regardless of the specific political leadership currently in power in Cuba, we cannot, in good conscience, remain passive or silent. It is morally imperative that we act when vulnerable populations are being deliberately subjected to severe economic hardship and deprivation. This suffering is not the result of natural disaster, but is a direct consequence of political pressure stemming from the United States government's continued pursuit of a regime change. The convoy is a testament to the principle that humanitarian concerns must transcend political disagreements and economic warfare. ** Follow our time in Cuba on IG, TikTok, Facebook, and UpScrolled @Mvmt4freedom! | | In Solidarity,The Movement for Freedom Team** | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2026 Movement 4 Freedom. clean_body: A very good friend of mine is running for a very important post in Texas, and I’m asking you to help him reach his goal. | Fellow Patriot, My very good friend, Chip Roy, is running for Texas Attorney General. I've known Chip for a long time, and I can tell you with 100% certainty that there has been no fiercer fighter for the America First agenda than Chip. No one - and I really mean it - has fought harder to help President Trump scrap the policies of the Biden years and put our country on a path toward prosperity. In Congress, Chip has been a relentless voice for the conservative principles Texans believe in. He's fought to stop the cartels that are flooding our communities with drugs and crime. He's the leading voice in Congress fighting to protect the integrity of our elections and end voter fraud. And most importantly, he's working with President Trump to secure the border. Given that Texas is the crown jewel among Republican-leaning states, we need to ensure that we don't just elect any 'ole Republican to be their next Attorney General. Texas - and America - needs a fighter. And that fighter is Chip Roy. We need someone who will stand up to the liberal activists on the coasts who are eager to file lawsuits the moment Congress or the Trump Administration passes meaningful conservative reforms. There is ZERO doubt in my mind that with Chip Roy as the next Texas AG, conservative principles will not only be preserved, but we will have the fiercest warrior of them all to ensure that compliance, order, and the rule of law rule the day. So I'm asking you personally: Washington might be losing a conservative fighter, but Texas needs him. And I'm proud to stand with Chip Roy. — Ted Cruz | | PAID FOR BY TEXANS FOR CHIP ROY Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go, but .

clean_body: Here's how we can send more WFP champions to Congress in 2026: | | | Peter, Over the past several years, with your support, we’ve helped elect some of the most progressive members of Congress in a generation. Now, a new class of Working Families Party champions is running for Congress in the 2026 midterms. These candidates are running for a country where homes are affordable, health care is reliable, jobs pay enough to support a family, child care is available when and where we need it, and people have the time to actually live their lives. And they’re clear about how to get there: by taxing the rich and getting big money out of politics. But our candidates aren't just competing against the other names on the ballot. They’re also up against a tidal wave of corporate money determined to stop them before they can reach Congress. That includes WFP-endorsed Robert Peters, who is facing over $6 million in AIPAC-, crypto-, and AI-backed spending in his primary in Illinois' 2nd Congressional District on Tuesday.1 This is just the start. AIPAC, crypto billionaires, and Silicon Valley AI companies are gearing up to spend hundreds of millions more to defeat pro-worker candidates in Democratic primaries this year.2 Here’s the size of the warchests we’re up against: AIPAC-aligned groups: $96 million AI industry PACs: $150 million Crypto super PACs: $193 million And we’re already seeing the impact. Earlier this month, many of these same outside groups flooded the primary election in North Carolina’s fourth Congressional district with last-minute spending. Together, they made up about 90% of all super PAC spending in what became the most expensive primary in North Carolina history.3 The WFP candidate, Nida Allam, ended up falling short by less than one percent. Now, just days before the election, they've promised to dump $1.1 million to try and stop our momentum in IL-02. 4 They’re targeting Working Families Party candidates because they fearlessly stand up for so many of the things these big corporations don’t want — like Medicare for All, stronger unions, affordable housing, regulation of crypto and AI, and taxing the ultra-wealthy. But here's the good news: we’ve beaten this kind of massive spending before, and we can do it again. We've proven that we don’t need to match them dollar-for-dollar — but we DO need enough to make sure our messages can reach voters. Together, we can send more fearless leaders to Washington who answer to working people, not AIPAC, crypto billionaires, or Silicon Valley CEOs. In solidarity, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. , X, March 12, 2026 2\. , New York Times , February 1, 2026 3\. , The American Prospect , February 20, 2026 4\. , New York Times , March 7, 2026 Thoughts? name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: This is common sense.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
What they like to call ‘radical’, I believe is common sense.
I believe that in the wealthiest nation in the history of the world, when a person gets sick, they shouldn’t go bankrupt.
Common sense.
I believe that a minimum wage should cover the minimum cost to live.
Common sense.
And by the way — we should see that _not_ paying a minimum wage is _corporate welfare_ , because **big companies like Walmart and Amazon rely on the food stamp program and public coffers** to cover the wages that they won't pay.
I believe that homes are not slot machines for investors and Wall Street to extort working families out of every last dollar that they have.
When your landlord jacks up your rent overnight, or housing prices skyrocket because Wall Street treats our housing market like a casino, your government should fight for your ability to keep an affordable roof over your head.
And I believe that **our elected officials should take on abuses of corporate greed everywhere they find it**.
That is why I don’t — and never will — take money from industry lobbyists or corporations. **We deserve better**.
Now, our movement for real progress for everyday people will have to push harder than ever these next few years.

# [Tell Hegseth: "Lift Your Outrageous Ban on Photographers"](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5012a669-c229-464c-92c2-3222dd79c073/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | We're in a war that spiraling out of control, and the top focus of the Defense Secretary is banning photographers who don't make him look hot and hunky? _**" Pentagon bars press photographers over 'unflattering' Hegseth photos... Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's staff took issue with images taken in a rare briefing last week and decided to shut out photographers from two subsequent news conferences." ([Wash Post)](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1381b1de-70e4-4a7e-a982-728956f565ca/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**_ He actually banned photographers. How [vain](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tad05e56a-a107-40b1-8c66-92a4fdd9b132/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) do you have to be to do that? Is he going to ban mirrors too? Hegseth may be a joke, but this isn't. Trump and his team have been gradually limiting the media's access in order to keep the truth from getting out. And now they are doing in midst of war, and there's no way we can let that happen. [**Sign on and Tell Hegseth: "Lift Your Outrageous Ban on Photographers"**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te3dc5161-09ae-4157-bbf9-3272340f9806/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | | | |

Friends,
While his opponents fight each other (and file lawsuits), Brad is focused making life better for hardworking Georgians in all four corners of our state.
This week, Brad [**signed the Georgia School Choice Pledge**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=0185c0ad45&e=6036811227) and released his plan to enhance educational outcomes for all Georgians.
As a Christian, conservative businessman, Brad believes that parents - not government bureaucrats - know what’s best for their children’s education. As Governor, he will work toward the long-term goal of universal school choice, ensuring that every family has the freedom to choose the learning environment that best fits their children.
Click [**HERE**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=ca72076595&e=6036811227) to review Brad’s entire Blueprint for Georgia.
While other candidates are focused on politics, Brad is focused on solutions that expand opportunity for Georgia families. He will Stand for Georgia – No Matter What.
– Team Raff
---
[|
---](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=0b69617cb4&e=6036811227)
| |
[**Pledging to Fight for Students**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=ee39832ec8&e=6036811227)
---
| |

Brad continues to lead with bold ideas to improve Georgia’s education system. His new school choice proposal is gaining attention from families across the state who want greater control over their children’s education and more opportunities for students to succeed.
---
| |
School choice advancement policies will increase educational freedom by strengthening Georgia’s existing scholarship programs and moving the state toward universal school choice for families:
* **Raise the Georgia Promise Scholarship cap to 10 percent** of total education spending, up from the current cap of 1 percent of the previous year’s K-12 funding.

* **Increase the Georgia Tax Credit Scholarship Program cap from $120 million to $500 million** , allowing thousands more students to access scholarships.

* **Expand access** so families can choose the best education option for their children, including public schools, charter schools, private schools, and homeschooling.

* **Promote stronger accountability** across the education system by creating competition and giving parents greater influence over where their children learn.

---
|
---
| |
[**Brad’s Full Blueprint for Georgia**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=4d375401a6&e=6036811227)

| | **Augusta Chronicle: Georgia secretary of state arrives in Augusta on campaign swing**
Brad was recently in Augusta discussing his campaign plan and vision for Georgia’s future.
_"I hate to use the word 'affordable,' but I really think that's something that the next governor should work on," Raffensperger said. The best way of defeating the affordability challenge "is to create more good-paying jobs."_
_When businesses succeed, he said, "They need to hire more employees, and they can pay their employees more money."_
_And many of the best-paying jobs are tied to that growth, according to Raffensperger. Welders, electricians, and construction workers tend to command high hourly wages._
_"We need to get trades back in high school," he said. "Can you imagine if you're 18 years old, graduated with a high school diploma, never had any student loan debt, and you're going to make 30 bucks an hour?"_
_In many Georgia municipalities, he said, rises in property taxes are outpacing rises in Social Security benefits._
_"That's why I think the next governor needs to cut property taxes for seniors," Raffensperger said. "Don't get ahead of inflation. Don't get ahead of those valuations."_
Read the entire article [**HERE**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=c7647dc7bf&e=6036811227).
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
**WNEG: Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger responds to Latest Lawsuit from Abrams–Elias Allies**
Brad will always stand for safe, secure elections in the state of Georgia—no matter what.
_“For years, Georgia has faced politically motivated lawsuits designed to undermine voter confidence and weaken common-sense election safeguards,” said Raffensperger. “We have defeated claims from Stacey Abrams, Marc Elias, and their allies in court countless times to keep our election rolls clean. I am confident we will prevail again.”_
Read the entire interview [HERE](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=a284779d40&e=6036811227).

He’s had the pleasure of speaking to the Private Directors Association, the Marietta Metro Rotary, the Augusta Rotary, the Cartersville Rotary, business leaders in Paulding County, the American Council of Engineering Companies of Georgia, the Republican Jewish Coalition, and the Peachtree City Rotary.

name: Noah Forman
subject: Excited to join the team
body:
| | Hi Peter, I want to introduce myself. I’m Noah, and I recently joined Team MGP as the new Finance Director.

I’m excited to join this campaign because I believe in Marie’s leadership. She listens to folks here at home, always puts the district first, and leads with the same approach that took her from auto repair shop owner to Congresswoman – fighting every day for Southwest Washington.

Peter,
A Missouri court just ruled that the MAGA Republican gerrymander eliminating one of only two Democrat-held seats in the state is legal and can proceed.
This is a gutting loss for Democrats who had hoped the courts would invalidate the GOP's gerrymander on the grounds that they deliberately diluted the voting power of Black communities in the Kansas City region.

body:
#
Peter, as Veterans of the last round of America’s military misadventures, the last few weeks have been rough.
But our work is not over. Not by a long shot. And in just a moment, we’re going to ask you to double down on your past support and make a donation. But before we do, you deserve to know why.
The short answer is this: If we don’t do this work, no one else will. There is no other organization on the left that can do what VoteVets does. We speak directly to Veterans and their families. And right now? Those people feel like Trump’s turned his back on them.
We sacrificed a lot for this country. We took our leaders at their word when they told us we needed to deploy to war in order to defend our democracy. We left our friends and family behind, and weren’t the same after we came back.
We’re not asking for “Thank you for your service.” We don’t want anything more than we need to get by. We don’t need vengeance for the friends we lost. **What we want is for our leaders to learn from the mistakes we made 20 years ago so we don’t repeat them again.**
Trump promised he had. Instead, he dragged us into another war of choice with no strategy, no metrics for success, no exit plan. Veterans are angry. Trump and the GOP have shown who they truly are, and what they really care about.

subject: a reckless, misogynistic primadonna

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Here’s a real question for you: What do you even call a misogynistic primadonna who’s unbelievably reckless with taxpayer dollars, not to mention our actual national security and the safety of our troops?
There’s no word that does this man justice, so I guess we’ll just call him Pete Hegseth.
Yes, I’m back to talk about our Secretary of Defense, and how he’s running the department like a personal vanity project.
Right now, the U.S. is spending $1 billion a day on an illegal war in Iran. $1 billion a day!
And while you can bet that Donald Trump and Republicans are going to ask Congress for even more funding any day now, new reporting shows Hegseth’s Pentagon has been on a staggering spending spree with taxpayer dollars totally unrelated to this war.
In September alone, Hegseth spent $93 billion (yes, BILLION) on ridiculous, frivolous luxuries:
* $98,329 on a grand piano for the Air Force chief of staff’s home
* $9 million on king crab and lobster tail
* $15.1 million on ribeye steak
* $225 million on furniture, including $12,000 fruit basket stands and more than $60,000 worth of designer recliners
This particular spending happened just days before our government shut down for the longest time in U.S. history, and millions of Americans lost their SNAP benefits, went without pay, and worried about how they were going to feed their families.
It’s sick.
And instead of focusing on the reckless war in Iran or getting his budget in order, Pete Hegseth is so vain that his latest move is to ban the photographers who took ‘unflattering’ photos of him during his recent briefings.
By all accounts, he’s just as worried about the lighting in the press he’s getting as our national security or service members’ safety. (Don’t get me started on the personal makeup studio he wanted at the Pentagon.)
Donald Trump spent years promising his supporters he would “drain the swamp.” But the truth is, he filled the government with some of the most corrupt and unserious people imaginable, and Pete Hegseth might be the worst and most dangerous example.
Our troops deserve serious, thoughtful leadership, and American taxpayers deserve accountability for where their hard-earned money is going. We saw with Kristi Noem’s firing just last week that public outrage can impact this administration’s personnel decisions — so let’s get loud about this.
If you agree Pete Hegseth is unfit to serve as Secretary of Defense, add your name to my petition right now demanding his resignation. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/m2RPI1eS7kCc_cWV-MtmoQ2]
ADD YOUR NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/m2RPI1eS7kCc_cWV-MtmoQ2]
The longer Hegseth stays in power, the more damage he does — to our military, to our nation’s credibility, and to the American people’s trust.
Thank you for speaking out with me.
Sara

clean_body: 👀 | | | | | Peter, Over the last few weeks, I’ve started noticing something different about this race. People are paying attention. Last month, the Tennessean covered our campaign and the momentum building here in TN-5, including the news that we’ve been added to the DCCC’s Red-to-Blue program. That means people on the national level believe we can win this. It’s a sign that folks around the country are starting to look at what’s happening here. But the reason I decided to run hasn’t changed. As mayor, most of the job isn’t about partisan arguments. It’s about solving problems in your community and making sure things work the way they should. Roads that need fixing. Schools that need support. Public safety. The basic things people count on every day. I’ve always believed politics works better when we remember something simple: a pothole doesn’t have a partisan label. It just needs to get fixed. That’s the mindset I’ve tried to bring to serving my hometown, and it’s the same approach I’d bring to Congress. Live from Capitol Hill! Welcome to another episode of Breakthrough Hour, where we find ourselves amid escalating tensions in the Middle East and a 47‐year conflict involving Iran.

In this episode, I have fresh testimonies from the Roots of Revival Tour in Florida, and then I welcome Rick Green to unpack America’s spiritual history, just war, constitutional questions, and rising antisemitism among young conservatives.

Light A Candle Missionaries Michael and Kayla Coons join live from Iraq to describe revival, refugee ministry, and why they’re staying in a war zone.

Finally, Pastor Lorenzo Sewell leads a stirring call to persistent prayer, repentance, and revival in America and across the nations.

Don't miss it!

# [What I heard in Big Rapids](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=190864188&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkwODY0MTg4LCJpYXQiOjE3NzM0MzM4OTQsImV4cCI6MTc3NjAyNTg5NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.nsym7VvDLqOil26OPdfWzMWc2aQkFfACQgktXg8IhyA)
### If the government is only working for billionaires, then it's not really working at all
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Mar 13
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..BFUr8ubokOFAK_T8AjetiwP0X8HeyNmDeSVYu3EYsYQ?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/what-i-heard-in-big-rapids?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

**I spent part of last Saturday in Big Rapids at the Farmers Forum at Ferris State University.** I got to hear directly from the folks who fuel our state about what's happening in rural Michigan - and the kind of leadership people are looking for right now.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/585d6a7e-ba47-44fb-b1d8-41c3ee68b45d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And I'll tell you this: Farmers need people in government who will actually listen. And then deliver results.
**Because the challenges are real.** Michigan farmers are facing rising costs, uncertain markets, and supply chain headaches. There are real questions about tariffs, labor, the farm bill, fuel prices, and the future of family farms and rural communities.
You could feel some uncertainty in the room. Folks are unsure about what the future holds.
But you could also feel something else: _Pride._
That's the Michigan way.
Even when times are tough, there is still so much pride in the work. In our state. In our community. In the idea that what you do matters.
And it does.
**Michigan farmers are a huge part of what makes this state run.** So when I hear about policies that make their jobs harder, I take it personally.
When tariffs make it tougher to plan, tougher to sell, and tougher to stay competitive, that's not some abstract policy debate to me. I see real faces and real people, and I'm determined to help. You can bet I'm going to fight harder than ever to relieve the burden on folks who are already doing some of the hardest work there is.
But let's zoom out for a second, because this is what really gets me:**Too often in this country, the people doing the hardest work get the least help.**
It's true.
The wealthiest people get tax breaks. The most connected people get access to politicians.
Meanwhile, Michigan farmers are paying more, too many rural hospitals are hanging on by a thread or closing, and working families in small towns are too often forgotten altogether.
I'm sorry, but that's crazy to me. It's backwards - and it doesn't have to be that way.
**Government can actually work for people.**
I know, I know, I can already feel some of you rolling your eyes. You're thinking that sounds like pie-in-the-sky talk.
But hear me out, because it's true. _I 've seen it._
**This is what public service is supposed to be.**
Government can help lower costs. It can support rural health care. It can invest in roads, ports, and infrastructure. It can help farmers get their goods to market and lower costs. It can create fairer trade policy. It can strengthen the supply chains that rural economies depend on. And it can treat the people who grow our food like they matter - because they do.
**I believe in a government that respects work.** A government that makes your life easier, not harder.
That's why I'm running for Senate - to make sure the government _is_ working for working people.
Not more chaos. Not more handouts for billionaires. Not more out-of-touch politicians acting like rural communities are an afterthought.
That's why I was glad to be in Big Rapids.
Not just because I got to talk policy, but also because I got to listen. And whenever I get to spend time with hardworking Michiganders, I come away even more certain about what this race - and this work - is really about.
It's about building a Michigan where the people who feed our families, teach our kids, build our cars, fix our equipment, care for our parents, and keep communities going strong don't feel like they're on their own.
It's about making sure working folks, especially in rural communities, aren't treated like an afterthought.
**It 's about remembering that if the government is only working for billionaires and insiders, then it's not really working at all.**
And it's about fighting for a future where the people doing the real work finally get a government that really works for them.
That's what I'm in this for.
For Michigan.
With grit,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

Let’s be honest about something: Lauren Boebert is beatable.
But only if we nominate a candidate who can actually win this district.
I know this district because I’m from here. I was born and raised right here in Colorado, and I’ve spent years building relationships across our communities — from the Front Range to the Eastern Plains.
I’ve fought for working people at the AFL-CIO, worked in science and technology as a public servant, and helped pass bipartisan legislation in Washington. And I’ve built a coalition that includes labor unions, ranchers, and community leaders.
Meanwhile, one of my primary opponents just moved here to run for this seat after voting for Donald Trump twice. Another has never built the broad coalition needed to beat Boebert.
This race is too important for guesswork.
If we want to defeat Lauren Boebert, we need a candidate with the backbone to take her on — and the campaign to win.
I’m that candidate.
But I can’t do it alone. If you’re ready to flip this seat and send Boebert packing, I’m asking you to chip in today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/trisha-dsg-email?]

In case you missed it, a MAGA-aligned group is sending outrageous mailers to voters across Virginia right now:

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Peter, This morning we learned the terrible news that six more Americans are dead today after a KC-135 tanker crashed over Iraq. I know that aircraft. I have flown missions supported by that aircraft. **I mourn for these fallen heroes, I pray for their families, and I believe in my bones that they deserved more from their commander in chief than a war built on arrogance and wishful thinking.** [**Donate now to help send a combat aviator to Congress who will demand accountability from those who recklessly start conflicts with no plan to end them.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8xKjesaM5ruxgxIiD1UDKcmz2AXY35Oou5dDbagtJwT-sE_HW_3YW3yyycJV_2pty3u__Jf9Ok2Jn4PYES4GOMPNhLFt3yzdR8MHZdn1bkIsWxc25pjYSNrWu16qBUCZmzOoxKH-eLJ6CfdlZTT6OxXk32X31ucH9lC71CzQ8CySUmGgTeu2RA3Prisc5F5Hm4aT5Q1NuthxZGwK0T3Mg3bei8XNiJQ9umm2cIFwtHVtRbAH7-aVxpaM1S_ba4-32AlCVlkHhzPcAioNa1Hx8SvP9X2avwYj-XqkkgIhUt1i/4ow/gRTnmWiyT4GeLJVR4HHAdA/h1/h001.PfZRV0dKxMuNm66knb1JowcCoHXbaFjVtZZkKj2gKPU) As a combat aviator, I deployed to the Middle East and flew missions supporting the war in Afghanistan. I sat in briefing rooms where we planned for every pressure point in that region. **One of the biggest scenarios we prepared for, the one that appeared at the top of every risk assessment, every strategic planning document, was the threat of Iran closing the Strait of Hormuz.** Every military planner who has spent five minutes thinking about a conflict with Iran has prepared for that. It is the most obvious, most predictable, most thoroughly war-gamed consequence of striking Iran that exists. CNN is now reporting that the Trump administration's national security team failed to fully account for Iran closing the strait. Top officials acknowledged in classified briefings that they simply did not plan for it. **This is beyond embarrassing. This is an abject failure of leadership and there should be consequences.** In any military chain of command I was ever part of, this level of planning failure would end careers. Keith Self knows all of this. As a combat veteran and commander himself, he understands exactly what criminal negligence at the strategic planning level looks like and what it costs the men and women at the bottom of that chain of command. He is cheering this all on anyway. That is what makes his position so morally indefensible. We need combat veterans in Congress desperately, but we need ones who remember why they raised their right hand in the first place. Keith Self traded that understanding for a MAGA loyalty test a long time ago. Every family getting that knock on the door deserves better. Every American watching their gas prices climb and their grocery bills spike because this administration couldn't be bothered to plan for the single most predictable consequence of their own war deserves better. [**Help me get to Congress and fight for all of them.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt8xKjesaM5ruxgxIiD1UDKcmz2AXY35Oou5dDbagtJwT-31bjS-oRHZnC2_e3-jmBDak4kZPWdSADb6y3MP8bYA9CCGvTnRD2kuUwaAxe-Y_E1ecqVNO28wP9ATtJ6Tv8hFRdrm21SH9zEkHpUaOlCAp4NwS-XJxrTzVGbQyexHx1W9nlTKgUtsNcJKJTnv-RDfnxlha5HXm3C2wnw-y9K8YxPB7XqH4ac0GhUdVFR2iOglTOk5Mucl50EORg_mGQeuCS9-UHU_f516GcL0aIK64vnAIu3OUqXxccQf1xIy-m/4ow/gRTnmWiyT4GeLJVR4HHAdA/h2/h001.FfwEL4CyMH6eSFNp8kP9zxVbYeMvpVfBg8m9bCP4A98) Very respectfully, Evan Hunt Candidate for U.S. Congress TX-03

clean_body: This is a failure of leadership and our troops are paying the price. | | Peter, This morning we learned the terrible news that six more Americans are dead today after a KC-135 tanker crashed over Iraq. I know that aircraft. I have flown missions supported by that aircraft. I mourn for these fallen heroes, I pray for their families, and I believe in my bones that they deserved more from their commander in chief than a war built on arrogance and wishful thinking. As a combat aviator, I deployed to the Middle East and flew missions supporting the war in Afghanistan. I sat in briefing rooms where we planned for every pressure point in that region. One of the biggest scenarios we prepared for, the one that appeared at the top of every risk assessment, every strategic planning document, was the threat of Iran closing the Strait of Hormuz. Every military planner who has spent five minutes thinking about a conflict with Iran has prepared for that. It is the most obvious, most predictable, most thoroughly war-gamed consequence of striking Iran that exists. CNN is now reporting that the Trump administration's national security team failed to fully account for Iran closing the strait. Top officials acknowledged in classified briefings that they simply did not plan for it. This is beyond embarrassing. This is an abject failure of leadership and there should be consequences. In any military chain of command I was ever part of, this level of planning failure would end careers. Keith Self knows all of this. As a combat veteran and commander himself, he understands exactly what criminal negligence at the strategic planning level looks like and what it costs the men and women at the bottom of that chain of command. He is cheering this all on anyway. That is what makes his position so morally indefensible. We need combat veterans in Congress desperately, but we need ones who remember why they raised their right hand in the first place. Keith Self traded that understanding for a MAGA loyalty test a long time ago. Every family getting that knock on the door deserves better. Every American watching their gas prices climb and their grocery bills spike because this administration couldn't be bothered to plan for the single most predictable consequence of their own war deserves better. Very respectfully, Evan Hunt Candidate for U.S. Congress TX-03 | | | Evan Hunt is a combat aviator and veteran, a community and business leader, and a Texas family man, running against MAGA Rep. There is almost universal agreement among Democrats that Trump's illegal war in Iran is a mistake. The overwhelming majority of elected Democratic officials have spoken out against this conflict and have stated that it is illegal, immoral, and should end. But there is a pocket of Democrats who are strongly considering supporting supplemental funding legislation that will fund Donald Trump's illegal war. And I want to make something clear: it would be a tremendous mistake for any Democrat in any part of this country to vote for that.
If you vote to fund Donald Trump's illegal war, you are choosing to endorse it. There is no way to separate the two.
* * *
_**Today 's rant is sponsored by Incogni.** _
_Because of the political commentary I do --especially calling out Donald Trump and his administration--I've received threats over the years. Not just against me, but against my family._
_When that happens, you start thinking a lot more about how easy it is for people to find your personal information online._
_Data brokers collect and sell your information --your phone number, address, and more--to anyone willing to pay. That's how scammers and identity thieves often find their targets._
_That 's why I use Incogni. They work to remove your personal data from broker sites and keep monitoring for new exposures._

* * *
I understand the instinct that a lot of Democratic elected officials are going to have. They're going to be scared to be seen as not providing our military servicemen and women with the resources they need to keep them safe. I recognize that that is a real thing. But Donald Trump is the one who is putting our men and women--many of them young kids--into harm's way and getting them killed in a war that he has not articulated a clear case for and that he has not asked Congress to authorize.
If you vote to fund the war, you support the war, period. There is no amount of political messaging that will allow you to get away with that. And even if you try to separate your personal views from the politics of it, voters don't make that distinction. The choices you make in office are your politics, and people will judge them accordingly. I believe the Democratic Party base will punish you for that.
Keep in mind, this conflict in and of itself is already unpopular, with the majority of Americans saying that they do not support or understand what Donald Trump is doing here. You would be putting yourself at tremendous political risk by voting to fund this.
This is also about accountability. Simply calling yourself a Democrat does not give you a free pass to support harmful decisions, especially in a moment as chaotic and dangerous as the one we are living through under the Trump administration. Elected officials serve the American people, not their own political comfort. And when the overwhelming majority of Americans say they do not support this war, it is the responsibility of their representatives to listen.
This is simply an unnecessary war. There has been no credible explanation for why this conflict is required to protect the United States, no clear objective, and no defined end. The American people have lived through too many wars launched on vague promises and shifting justifications to blindly accept another one.
This is not post-9/11 America. There is not a well of goodwill for the United States to engage in foreign military conflicts like this, nor should there be after the Bush administration squandered that goodwill with its idiotic and deadly invasion of Iraq.
This is a country where, at this moment, the vast majority of Americans are struggling. People can't afford to put food on the table. They can't afford to buy a house, take a vacation, or retire with dignity. There are kids graduating from college with mountains of student loan debt into a workforce where there are no jobs for them. Families are struggling to afford rent, groceries, gas, and basic healthcare.
It is also only a matter of time before this conflict collapses under its own weight. When decisions are rushed, when laws are ignored, when consequences are not considered, and when basic economic realities are brushed aside, failure is inevitable. This kind of reckless governance is not sustainable.
At the same time, Americans are watching a political class that promised something very different. Leaders who campaigned on keeping us out of unnecessary wars are now dragging the country into new ones. Officials who claim to stand for law and order are casually throwing around accusations of "domestic terrorism" against people they disagree with while defending their own allies.
And people are noticing.
This administration has been so craven and so transparent in its tactics that more and more Americans are seeing right through it. And it's not just about Donald Trump anymore. People are starting to recognize the deeper corruption and dysfunction in Washington as a whole.
Look at the Epstein scandal. For years, Americans have watched powerful people across government, finance, and politics evade accountability while the truth about who was involved and how deep it went remains buried. That kind of rot doesn't just disappear. It erodes trust in institutions and reinforces what millions of Americans already believe: that there is one set of rules for the powerful and another for everyone else. That same loss of trust is exactly why Americans are not willing to blindly accept another war whose purpose has never been clearly explained.
So when politicians vote to send billions and billions of dollars overseas for a war that nobody can clearly explain, while Americans at home are struggling to survive, people are not going to shrug and move on.
They are going to push back.
People are waking up.
A strong country is not one that rushes into unnecessary wars. A strong country understands the cost of conflict and treats it with the seriousness it deserves. These reckless actions upend the lives of millions of people in other countries and destabilize entire regions. When a nation has that kind of power, it demands restraint--and the humility to learn from the mistakes America has made in the past.
The trillions of dollars we have spent on endless conflicts overseas could have rebuilt communities here at home. Our focus must be on investing in the American people and supporting our allies like Ukraine, where our involvement can make our country a force for good--where our investment keeps Americans safe.
Do not be complicit in this war. If you vote to fund it, history will remember exactly where you stood.

Power without restraint only repeats the mistakes of the past. | | | Mar 13 | | | | | | | | | | | | There is almost universal agreement among Democrats that Trump's illegal war in Iran is a mistake. The overwhelming majority of elected Democratic officials have spoken out against this conflict and have stated that it is illegal, immoral, and should end. But there is a pocket of Democrats who are strongly considering supporting supplemental funding legislation that will fund Donald Trump's illegal war. And I want to make something clear: it would be a tremendous mistake for any Democrat in any part of this country to vote for that. If you vote to fund Donald Trump's illegal war, you are choosing to endorse it. There is no way to separate the two. Today 's rant is sponsored by Incogni. Because of the political commentary I do --especially calling out Donald Trump and his administration--I've received threats over the years. Not just against me, but against my family. When that happens, you start thinking a lot more about how easy it is for people to find your personal information online. Data brokers collect and sell your information --your phone number, address, and more--to anyone willing to pay. That's how scammers and identity thieves often find their targets. That 's why I use Incogni. They work to remove your personal data from broker sites and keep monitoring for new exposures. I understand the instinct that a lot of Democratic elected officials are going to have. They're going to be scared to be seen as not providing our military servicemen and women with the resources they need to keep them safe. I recognize that that is a real thing. But Donald Trump is the one who is putting our men and women--many of them young kids--into harm's way and getting them killed in a war that he has not articulated a clear case for and that he has not asked Congress to authorize. If you vote to fund the war, you support the war, period. There is no amount of political messaging that will allow you to get away with that. And even if you try to separate your personal views from the politics of it, voters don't make that distinction. The choices you make in office are your politics, and people will judge them accordingly. I believe the Democratic Party base will punish you for that. Keep in mind, this conflict in and of itself is already unpopular, with the majority of Americans saying that they do not support or understand what Donald Trump is doing here. You would be putting yourself at tremendous political risk by voting to fund this. This is also about accountability. Simply calling yourself a Democrat does not give you a free pass to support harmful decisions, especially in a moment as chaotic and dangerous as the one we are living through under the Trump administration. Elected officials serve the American people, not their own political comfort. And when the overwhelming majority of Americans say they do not support this war, it is the responsibility of their representatives to listen. This is simply an unnecessary war. There has been no credible explanation for why this conflict is required to protect the United States, no clear objective, and no defined end. The American people have lived through too many wars launched on vague promises and shifting justifications to blindly accept another one. This is not post-9/11 America. There is not a well of goodwill for the United States to engage in foreign military conflicts like this, nor should there be after the Bush administration squandered that goodwill with its idiotic and deadly invasion of Iraq. This is a country where, at this moment, the vast majority of Americans are struggling. People can't afford to put food on the table. They can't afford to buy a house, take a vacation, or retire with dignity. There are kids graduating from college with mountains of student loan debt into a workforce where there are no jobs for them. Families are struggling to afford rent, groceries, gas, and basic healthcare. It is also only a matter of time before this conflict collapses under its own weight. When decisions are rushed, when laws are ignored, when consequences are not considered, and when basic economic realities are brushed aside, failure is inevitable. This kind of reckless governance is not sustainable. At the same time, Americans are watching a political class that promised something very different. Leaders who campaigned on keeping us out of unnecessary wars are now dragging the country into new ones. Officials who claim to stand for law and order are casually throwing around accusations of "domestic terrorism" against people they disagree with while defending their own allies. And people are noticing. This administration has been so craven and so transparent in its tactics that more and more Americans are seeing right through it. And it's not just about Donald Trump anymore. People are starting to recognize the deeper corruption and dysfunction in Washington as a whole. Look at the Epstein scandal. For years, Americans have watched powerful people across government, finance, and politics evade accountability while the truth about who was involved and how deep it went remains buried. That kind of rot doesn't just disappear. It erodes trust in institutions and reinforces what millions of Americans already believe: that there is one set of rules for the powerful and another for everyone else. That same loss of trust is exactly why Americans are not willing to blindly accept another war whose purpose has never been clearly explained. So when politicians vote to send billions and billions of dollars overseas for a war that nobody can clearly explain, while Americans at home are struggling to survive, people are not going to shrug and move on. They are going to push back. People are waking up. A strong country is not one that rushes into unnecessary wars. A strong country understands the cost of conflict and treats it with the seriousness it deserves. These reckless actions upend the lives of millions of people in other countries and destabilize entire regions. When a nation has that kind of power, it demands restraint--and the humility to learn from the mistakes America has made in the past. The trillions of dollars we have spent on endless conflicts overseas could have rebuilt communities here at home. Our focus must be on investing in the American people and supporting our allies like Ukraine, where our involvement can make our country a force for good--where our investment keeps Americans safe. Do not be complicit in this war. If you vote to fund it, history will remember exactly where you stood. P.S. If you're outspoken online--or just value your privacy--it's worth checking how much of your personal data is floating around the internet. body:
Allowing ICE agents to "surround" our polling places is direct voter intimidation. This is an agency that routinely targets citizens based on skin color and arrests legitimate citizens without warning. Threatening eligible voters -- or wrongly arresting them -- at a polling place would be a gross violation of our constitutional rights, including our fundamental right to vote.
Stand against this blatant threat of intimidation and violence. Demand your state Secretary of State keeps ICE away from the polls >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/no-ice-at-the-polls/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
MAGA operatives are calling on Donald Trump to deploy ICE agents to polling locations during the midterm elections, Folks
The intent is obvious. They want to intimidate voters , especially in immigrant communities and communities of color, and create fear at the ballot box .
Noncitizen voting is already illegal under federal law. Multiple investigations and fact-checks have repeatedly confirmed it is exceedingly rare. Election officials from both parties acknowledge there is no evidence of widespread noncitizen voting . Yet extremists continue to push this lie as a pretext to flood polling places with immigration agents.
Let’s be 100% clear: ICE agents do not belong at polling locations. Ever.
Send a direct message to your state Secretary of State demanding clear, public action to keep ICE away from polling places and protect voters from intimidation and violence now >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/no-ice-at-the-polls/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

ICE has admitted to racial profiling. There are now countless reports of American citizens threatened and detained purely because of the color of their skin.
The mere presence of ICE at or near polling sites would have a chilling effect because many eligible voters would stay home out of fear. Families would question whether exercising their constitutional right could put loved ones at risk. That is voter suppression by design.
Secretaries of State are the chief election officials in their states , not the federal government and definitely not ICE. Secretaries of State have the authority and the responsibility to ensure polling locations are safe, neutral, and free from intimidation. They must make it clear now that ICE has no role at the polls and that any attempt to interfere with voters will be met with firm opposition.
Protect our elections from intimidation and violence. body:
We have to fight back. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127281546/607533803/-1903256646?refcode=-SB-&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzQ1MDhlN2MtMjMxZi1mMTExLTlhNDgtMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-uDyqk2Iz32yKTNumWBZ0pLQApJ8jVJrI3r_czqoorI=) | Peter, Today I want to have a serious conversation about what’s happening in our country and the dangerous rise of extremism and white supremacy. For years, we’ve seen the rhetoric of hate and division used to distract us from the real threats to our communities. We are told to fear immigrant families coming to our country in search of a better life — people who want exactly what our own ancestors wanted: safety and opportunity. **But if we’re being honest about what truly threatens the fabric of our democracy, it’s the rising tide of white supremacy and domestic extremism.** The numbers don't lie. Over the last decade, white supremacists have been responsible for the vast majority of extremist-related murders in the U.S. In some years, nearly 80% of all domestic extremist killings were committed by those with ties to white supremacist ideologies and right-wing groups. name: Team Pappas
subject: Why this race matters to us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
The stakes in this race couldn’t be higher.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=5566%2E582294%2E9fN5Cu)
Team,
This email is about why Chris Pappas’s run for U.S. Senate matters.
If you’re already on board, **[please make a contribution of $5 before our critical end-of-quarter deadline on March 31st.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260313_2.9rsEeB&refcode=em20260313-2&t=2&akid=5566%2E582294%2E9fN5Cu)**
The stakes in this race couldn’t be higher:
Our economy, our democracy, and our basic freedoms are all on the line — **and control of the Senate will come down to New Hampshire.**
Granite Staters deserve a Senator who understands our communities, lives our values, and is ready to deliver on day one.
March 31st is our __first__ FEC fundraising deadline of the year, and it will shape how this campaign is viewed heading towards November. This isn’t just any deadline – National Republicans and their right-wing billionaire allies are watching to see if we meet our goals or if we fall short. _We can’t let that happen._
Chris’s opponent is John Sununu – he’s part of a political dynasty, with a national fundraising machine and a personal endorsement from Donald Trump. **Sununu is exactly the kind of candidate national Republicans want to help them cling to Senate control.**
**[We’re counting on you to step up and support Chris’s campaign today. Can we count on you to back this campaign with a $5 contribution right before our end-of-quarter deadline?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260313_2.9rsEeB&refcode=em20260313-2&t=3&akid=5566%2E582294%2E9fN5Cu)**
**[Chip in $5 Now »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260313_2.9rsEeB&amount=5&refcode=em20260313-2&t=4&akid=5566%2E582294%2E9fN5Cu)**
_Chris embodies the values we hold in New Hampshire. It’s why he’s in this race and why he’ll fight so hard for all of us in the Senate._
Chris learned the power of hard work and community helping run his family’s century-old restaurant in Manchester. As opportunities for working families and small business owners get harder to come by and Republicans hand out tax breaks to their right-wing billionaires donors and corporate special interests, Chris champions our local communities.
Chris has won four tough races in one of the swingiest districts in the country. He has proven time and time again that he has what it takes to fight back against extremism in Congress and work for all of us.. But he needs your help in order to succeed.
**[Let’s blow the GOP out of the water and show the strength of our grassroots campaign. Can you chip in $5 or more before the first end-of-quarter deadline of the year to help Chris in the fight to retake the Senate?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260313_2.9rsEeB&refcode=em20260313-2&t=5&akid=5566%2E582294%2E9fN5Cu)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260313_2.9rsEeB&amount=5&refcode=em20260313-2&t=24&akid=5566%2E582294%2E9fN5Cu)**
Thank you for all that you do,
Team Pappas
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20260313-2&t=25&refcode2=5566_582294_9fN5Cu&akid=5566%2E582294%2E9fN5Cu)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:

body:
This week, the New Hampshire House has just delivered two resounding victories for liberty, family, and self-determination.

| | | | | [|
---](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=64414dcfc0&e=8c8e704ee6)
| | | | | | Peter,

**Liberty is WINNING in New Hampshire!**

This week, the New Hampshire House has just delivered two resounding victories for liberty, family, and self-determination.

HB 1268, the Home Education Freedom Act, and HB 1706, the bill that stops state funding of federal refugee resettlement programs, both passed with strong support.

These are not small steps. They are declarations that New Hampshire will not bow to unnecessary government control.
---
[|
---](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=1d8387c888&e=8c8e704ee6)
| [KEEP THE MOMENTUM ALIVE BY JOINING CITIZENS ALLIANCE OF NEW HAMPSHIRE TODAY >>>](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=22c34ac103&e=8c8e704ee6)
---
| | **HB 1268 restores parents as the rightful leaders of their children’s education.**

By making initial notifications and annual evaluations optional, ending district micromanagement, and protecting families from paperwork being weaponized in truancy or welfare cases, this bill removes the heavy hand of bureaucracy and trusts parents to do what is best for their own children.

New Hampshire will soon be positioned to become the gold standard for home education freedom in the entire country once this bill passes the Senate and is signed into law.

Parents can breathe easier knowing the state is finally getting out of the way.

**HB 1706 reclaims New Hampshire’s resources for Granite Staters.**

It prohibits the Department of Health and Human Services from accepting or spending any state funds on the refugee resettlement program. This ends state government involvement and funding in the federal program, shifting any continued resettlement services to non-governmental organizations.

These victories belong to every one of you who made calls, sent emails, and stood firm. They also belong to our Pledge Champions in Good Standing who honored their commitment to limited government, parental rights, and individual liberty. When lawmakers keep their word, we all win.

**The fight is far from over.**

We need your help to keep the pressure on, defend these gains, and push even more freedom-forward legislation through the Senate and beyond.

If you believe in a New Hampshire where families lead, where the state stays out of the way, and where our resources serve our own people first, please join the fight today: [CitizensAllianceNH.org/donate](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=7e8b45b359&e=8c8e704ee6)

Let’s keep the momentum alive!

For New Hampshire,

The war in Iran is already causing chaos and higher costs for Americans already struggling to make ends meet.

As America is now spending billions of dollars overseas, working families back home can’t afford health care, groceries, and housing. In the past week, gas prices have shot up over 50 cents per gallon.

Donald Trump campaigned on ending wars. Instead, he bombed seven countries in his first year in office, including Iran. We have been here before, and the American people are rightfully pissed.

After decades of conflict, trillions of taxpayer dollars spent, and thousands of lives lost, the American people are exhausted by forever wars.

We cannot keep repeating the same mistakes. Yet Trump took military action in Venezuela, is threatening to seize Greenland, and now has started a war with Iran. He’s tearing apart our alliances and making America less safe.

Jason served in combat. America shouldn't be afraid to use our strength, and we have a positive role to play in the world. But Iran did not present an imminent threat, and this is a war of choice. Americans are exhausted by Middle East wars and tired of spending billions of dollars overseas. They want us to focus on making life more affordable for Americans at home.

name: Adam Gray
subject: I'm running for re-election
body:
I’m running to keep Washington focused on the people it’s supposed to serve.

| |
---
Friend, I wanted you to be one of the first to hear this: **I’m officially launching my re-election campaign in California’s 13th Congressional district.** From day one, my focus has been on delivering real results for folks here in the Central Valley. I’m running for re-election because the Valley deserves to be represented by someone who knows our community, stands up to partisan extremists on both sides, and is focused on solving the issues our communities face. These aren’t just empty promises to score political points — and despite the chaos we see in the media, I’m proud of what we’ve been able to accomplish together in my first term.
* We’ve worked to lower food prices by pushing back on costly tariff policies that raise prices for families and our farmers.
* We secured $16 million in federal investments for flood protection, water treatment, and critical road and infrastructure repairs across the Central Valley.
* We helped move forward bipartisan work to strengthen agricultural communities and make sure farmers can keep feeding families across the country.

And I’ve worked to expand healthcare access for veterans and rural communities, while protecting benefits that help the most vulnerable families put food on the table. **But we still have work to do, friend. I’ve proven I’ll work with anyone, Democrat or Republican, to lower costs, strengthen our farms and small businesses, and make life better for Valley families — and that’s exactly what I’ll keep doing.** I also want to let you know directly what we’re up against this cycle. _**This race was the closest in the entire country last election – decided by just 187 votes.**_ Now, Republicans are already planning to invest millions to elect an extreme candidate handpicked by DC insiders. That’s not the kind of voice the Central Valley deserves. The more support we have early in this campaign, the stronger our path to victory will be as we see the other side pour millions of dollars in dark money into this race. clean_body: I’m running to keep Washington focused on the people it’s supposed to serve. | | Friend, I wanted you to be one of the first to hear this: I’m officially launching my re-election campaign in California’s 13th Congressional district. From day one, my focus has been on delivering real results for folks here in the Central Valley. I’m running for re-election because the Valley deserves to be represented by someone who knows our community, stands up to partisan extremists on both sides, and is focused on solving the issues our communities face. These aren’t just empty promises to score political points — and despite the chaos we see in the media, I’m proud of what we’ve been able to accomplish together in my first term. We’ve worked to lower food prices by pushing back on costly tariff policies that raise prices for families and our farmers. We secured $16 million in federal investments for flood protection, water treatment, and critical road and infrastructure repairs across the Central Valley. We helped move forward bipartisan work to strengthen agricultural communities and make sure farmers can keep feeding families across the country. And I’ve worked to expand healthcare access for veterans and rural communities, while protecting benefits that help the most vulnerable families put food on the table. But we still have work to do, friend. I’ve proven I’ll work with anyone, Democrat or Republican, to lower costs, strengthen our farms and small businesses, and make life better for Valley families — and that’s exactly what I’ll keep doing. I also want to let you know directly what we’re up against this cycle. This race was the closest in the entire country last election – decided by just 187 votes. Now, Republicans are already planning to invest millions to elect an extreme candidate handpicked by DC insiders. That’s not the kind of voice the Central Valley deserves. The more support we have early in this campaign, the stronger our path to victory will be as we see the other side pour millions of dollars in dark money into this race. Friend, the path to a majority runs right through the Central Valley — that’s why I need people like you on my team from the very beginning. =** | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. I don’t take your support for granted. I’m grateful to serve this district, and I’ll always make sure Washington never loses sight of the people it’s supposed to serve. ### The next great American sound isn't coming from LA or Brooklyn--it's coming from Nashville's songwriting rooms.
