Nashville is doing what America does at its best: taking something old, something true, and making it new without pretending it came from nowhere.

For years, the smart set in the music press liked to treat Nashville as if it were either a museum for traditional country or a factory for radio formulas. That was always too neat, too small, and too lazy. The city was never just cowboy hats and three chords. It was always a songwriting town first, a place where structure mattered, where melody mattered, where emotion had to hit hard enough to survive outside the room where it was written.
Now that truth is getting harder to ignore.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.m7lZTGiY6hM8_o-tLEU-cU_JJvDMTUyf5cQkWc1rZj4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=190863562)
The latest proof is what some are calling Nashville's "Southern pop" moment, a sound built by artists like Jessie Murph and sharpened by songwriters like Laura Veltz and Ben Johnson. The Tennessean's framing is exactly right: Nashville is not abandoning country tradition. It is melting soulful pop into it, and in the process creating one of the few genuinely fresh American sounds of the moment.

Jessie Murph is probably the clearest example of where this is going. She is Nashville-born, Alabama-raised, and she has made it very clear she has no interest in being trapped inside one label. In interviews, she has said country will always be part of her sound because of where she is from, but she also says she does not see herself ever going "fully country." That matters, because it tells you this shift is not an accident or a marketing gimmick. It is an artist intentionally pulling from doo-wop, trap, country, blues, and pop because that is what modern Southern identity actually sounds like. Her 2025 album _Sex Hysteria_ blended '60s pop, early-2000s trap, and country, and it debuted at No. 8 on the Billboard 200.

But artists do not make movements alone. Cities do. Songwriters do. Infrastructure does.

That is where Laura Veltz comes in. Veltz is a Nashville songwriter in the old-school sense of the word--craft first, trend second. Yet she is also exactly the kind of writer capable of pushing a city into its next era. By October 2025, she had more than 10 released cuts with Jessie Murph and had co-written 11 Murph songs, including "Blue Strips" and "High Road." She described her recent work as applying traditional Nashville craftsmanship to pop, rock, R&B, and hip-hop--a new playground for old discipline. That is the key to this whole story. Nashville's competitive advantage is not costume. It is craftsmanship.

And that craftsmanship is producing commercial results, not just critic chatter. "High Road," performed by Koe Wetzel and Jessie Murph and co-written by Veltz, finished 2025 as the No. 1 most-played song of the year by Mediabase and Billboard, according to MusicRow. Veltz also earned a 2026 Grammy nomination for Songwriter of the Year, non-classical. This is not fringe experimentation happening in a warehouse for tastemakers. This is the center of the music business moving in real time.

Ben Johnson belongs in that conversation too. He has long been one of Nashville's major writing forces, and MusicRow ranked him No. 20 on its Top 100 Songwriters of 2024 list. His work spans modern country hits, but he also represents the kind of flexible, genre-aware writer-producer culture that allows Nashville to keep expanding without losing itself. That matters because scenes rise when their best people are not purists in the brittle sense. They know what to preserve and what to steal.

What makes this moment interesting is not simply that country is crossing over again. That happens every few years. What makes this different is that the crossover is no longer one-way. Nashville is not just exporting country into pop. It is importing pop, hip-hop, soul, and alternative textures back into a songwriting tradition tough enough to absorb them. The result is less polished than mainstream pop, less boxed-in than mainstream country, and far more emotionally direct than most algorithm-chasing streaming music.

In other words, it sounds Southern. It sounds American. It sounds like people who still believe songs should actually say something.

That is why Jessie Murph matters. That is why Laura Veltz matters. That is why Nashville matters.

Because in an age when so much culture feels assembled by committee, Nashville is still one of the few places where talent, discipline, and regional identity can collide and produce something real. Not nostalgia. Not cosplay. Not sterile "genre content." Something alive.

And maybe that is the bigger story here.

The future of American music may not come from Los Angeles trend forecasting or Brooklyn irony or some label boardroom trying to reverse-engineer virality. It may come from the same city that has always understood the power of a hook, the weight of a line, and the discipline it takes to turn raw emotion into a record people can't forget.

Nashville didn't stop being Nashville.

It just remembered that when you know who you are, you can build the next sound of the country without asking anyone's permission.

Youtuber and boxer Jake Paul **[asked President Donald Trump a very personal question](https://substack.com/redirect/71a3bf9f-ccd3-4482-8334-8d83184abac2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that no reporter has dared to ask him before, during their one-on-one sit down interview, released on Friday.

# Trump deploys 5,000 Marines to Hormuz
President Trump has **[ordered 5,000 Marines and additional warships to the Strait of Hormuz](https://substack.com/redirect/e90cf268-ca44-4df0-b880-097a352e396e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as U.S. tensions with Iran escalate, with the death toll reaching 13 American troops from incidents including a drone strike in Kuwait and a mid-air collision in Iraq, fueling fears of broader ground involvement and oil supply disruptions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e90cf268-ca44-4df0-b880-097a352e396e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **Iran Conflict Escalates Rapidly:** Iranian actions have strangled global oil flows through the Strait, spiking U.S. gas prices to $3.60 per gallon, with Trump considering seizing Iran's Kharg Island oil export hub handling 90% of regime fuel shipments.

Peter,

Trump and Republicans are pushing a bill called the SAVE Act that could
disenfranchise voters across the country.

This bill would require Americans to show proof of citizenship documents,
like a passport or birth certificate, just to register to vote. That might
sound easy to some politicians in Washington, but for millions of
Americans, it’s not.

Women who changed their last names after marriage, military families
stationed far from home, working people who cannot afford to replace lost
documents, and communities of color who already face barriers at the
ballot box are just some of those who would be affected.

Many people would have to pay for a passport or order a new birth
certificate just to vote. Let’s call this what it is: a poll tax.

Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida have been clear — this is voter
suppression, and just another play by Republicans to rig elections.

And the same forces pushing the SAVE Act are also working to defeat our
progressive champions, because when our leaders stand up for voting
rights, integrity, and justice, powerful interests will do anything to
silence them.

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Peter,

Thanks to you, Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida are making real
change. Together, we’ve fought for working families, defended healthcare,
and stood up to billionaires and powerful interests trying to control our
government.

But make no mistake: the opposition is relentless.

Well-funded attacks, misinformation campaigns, and political threats are
coming at them from every angle. Every day, voters are being misled,
protections for our communities are under threat, and progress we’ve
fought for is at risk of being rolled back.

Losing one of these progressive champions’ seats would have huge
consequences. It would give more power to those who put corporate
interests over working people, weaken protections for our communities, and
silence the movement we’ve built together.

We cannot let the opposition slow us down. Your support helps defend all
four seats, protect our communities, and keep winning real victories for
working people. It helps grow our people-powered movement that refuses to
be silenced, while ensuring the Squad can continue to speak truth to
power.

The Senate rejected a bipartisan resolution last week that would have narrowed Trump’s ability to launch future strikes on Iran. However, Murphy is signaling that Democrats’ attempts to limit the president’s power to wage war against Iran are just getting started.

Sen. Katie Britt, R-Ala., the chair of the Senate Homeland Security funding panel, scoffed at Murphy’s edict.

"The delay tactics we’re seeing from Democrats don’t change the fact that, because of their political games, lines at airports are growing, and the people tasked with keeping our homeland safe are being forced to do so without a paycheck," Britt said in a statement to Fox News Digital.

HUNTSVILLE, Ala. — U.S. Senator Katie Britt highlighted two recent federal investments in Alabama during her monthly press conference on Wednesday, praising a new Navy facility in Colbert County and the U.S. Coast Guard's acquisition of the former Birmingham-Southern College campus.

Sen. Britt credited Rep. Robert Aderholt and the Alabama congressional delegation for their role in securing the Navy facility, which will partner with manufacturing company Hadrian to produce defense components.

U.S. Sen. Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) said on Wednesday that she was "committed" to getting the SAVE America Act passed next week, including utilizing the talking filibuster.

During an interview on Fox News Channel's "The Will Cain Show," Alabama's junior U.S. Senator emphasized the importance of ensuring the nation's elections are "free and fair" by requiring voters to show proof of citizenship when registering and present photo identification when casting ballots.

Gas prices are surging. Oil markets are exploding. And the Trump administration insists the United States is **" not at war."**
In this week's **Shuster 's Weekly Wrap-Up**, David Shuster examines the economic and geopolitical fallout from the U.S. attacks on Iran.
Oil prices have jumped dramatically, the Strait of Hormuz is under threat, and global markets are bracing for oil potentially reaching **$200 per barrel**. At the same time, the U.S. labor market is weakening with major job losses reported across multiple sectors.
Shuster breaks down:
• Why oil prices are surging
• How the Iran conflict threatens global shipping routes
• The economic impact on American workers and farmers
• The political messaging from the Trump administration
• And this week's bizarre political moment involving Marco Rubio
If oil prices continue to spike, the result could be **higher inflation, economic slowdown, and escalating geopolitical risk.**

Peter,

While the rise in popularity of politicians like Zohran Mamdani and his socialist policies might have come as a shock to many, I've been warning people about it for years.

Younger Americans do not know what socialism means.

When younger Americans think of "socialism," they think it means Sweden and Denmark.

They didn't grow up during the Cold War. They don't remember the Soviet Union. Or Stalin's Gulags or the Warsaw Pact. They couldn't even tell you what the initials U.S.S.R. stood for, or that Nazi is the abbreviation of National Socialist.

**Young Americans need to hear about socialism, real socialism, from someone who experienced it firsthand. I can think of no one better than Ayn Rand.**

Rand wrote novels like _We The Living_ , which dramatized the inhumanity of the Soviet system -- and most importantly, _Atlas Shrugged_ , which dramatized what would happen if socialism came to America. Rand's immense success in making the moral case for capitalism led my friend, the late Ed Crane, to call her "the greatest all-time recruiter for the liberty movement."

The challenge is that young people simply aren't reading novels anymore. In the 70s, 70% of young people read fiction daily for fun -- today, less than 12% do.

That's where The Atlas Society comes in. They bring Ayn Rand's ideas to life for new audiences in innovative ways, including animated videos, viral social media, graphic novels -- even music videos. Plus online courses and live events.

clean_body: Peter, While the rise in popularity of politicians like Zohran Mamdani and his socialist policies might have come as a shock to many, I've been warning people about it for years. Younger Americans do not know what socialism means. When younger Americans think of "socialism," they think it means Sweden and Denmark. They didn't grow up during the Cold War. They don't remember the Soviet Union. Or Stalin's Gulags or the Warsaw Pact. They couldn't even tell you what the initials U.S.S.R. stood for, or that Nazi is the abbreviation of National Socialist. Young Americans need to hear about socialism, real socialism, from someone who experienced it firsthand. I can think of no one better than Ayn Rand. Rand wrote novels like We The Living , which dramatized the inhumanity of the Soviet system -- and most importantly, Atlas Shrugged , which dramatized what would happen if socialism came to America. Rand's immense success in making the moral case for capitalism led my friend, the late Ed Crane, to call her "the greatest all-time recruiter for the liberty movement." The challenge is that young people simply aren't reading novels anymore. In the 70s, 70% of young people read fiction daily for fun -- today, less than 12% do. That's where The Atlas Society comes in. They bring Ayn Rand's ideas to life for new audiences in innovative ways, including animated videos, viral social media, graphic novels -- even music videos. Plus online courses and live events. I told Jennifer Grossman, The Atlas Society's CEO, that I would help her raise $30,000 online this month to introduce more young minds to Ayn Rand's ideas. Otherwise, please let me explain why I believe The Atlas Society and its leadership are best suited to combat the rise in popularity of these harmful ideologies. First, Jennifer and I go back more than 35 years, when she was a White House Speechwriter, and Americans for Tax Reform was in its founding era. She's one of the most innovative, effective, and persevering executives I know. Over the past decade, she's built The Atlas Society into a juggernaut for freedom. The Atlas Society is the ONLY non-profit adapting Rand 's works into media that appeals to young Americans. Just one example: their animated book trailer for Atlas Shrugged drew 12 million views, and DOUBLED sales of the novel! They're currently producing a full-length feature film of Anthem, Rand's dystopian novella. I believe in their great work because I've seen the impact they've had. It's why I've collaborated with The Atlas Society on various discussions and interviews, including speaking at their student conferences, doing interviews on their podcast, and even doing stand-up comedy at one of their fundraising galas! Thank you, Grover Norquist P.S. If you still aren't convinced, let me tell you what will happen if young Americans fail to learn these important lessons. Without a moral philosophy based on reason, achievement, individualism, and freedom, the next generation will continue to embrace socialism and a culture of envy, entitlement, victimhood, and resentment. Young Americans lack the historical context to understand socialism 's outcomes. Ayn Rand's works challenge the ideas of socialism and teach us that everyone should be free to pursue their own understanding of the virtuous life. South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

If you're like me, you care about saving our Democracy. Let me tell you why I'm in this fight with you.
As a Capitol Police Officer and as an American, January 6th, 2021, was the darkest day of my life. I testified before Congress about what really happened. I spoke truth to power while some of the same people I protected tried to rewrite history and pretend it was just a "normal tourist visit."
The wounds that my heroic fellow officers endured are still healing. But my commitment to ensuring the strength of our democracy has only deepened.
#### It's the reason I decided to run for Congress for Maryland's 5th District.
I made this choice because I cannot sit idly by while our very right to survive is under attack by Donald Trump. I've fought against his angry mob before, and I'm ready to do it again.
So I'm asking you to make a choice:
\-- Either we sit back, let the bigots win, and allow dark money to buy this seat out from under us.
\-- Or we can step up and prove we won't surrender in the face of hate.
**[MAGA extremists will fight like hell to destroy our campaign. I need you with me in this fight. I'm humbly asking you to donate to my campaign. We set an 80,000 End-Of-Quarter donor goal to supercharge this campaign and build our movement. If you can, rush $5 (or more) right now to help us hit this ambitious end-of-quarter goal and show we're serious about winning this seat:](https://substack.com/redirect/18b9187d-3606-418e-bfde-3e14aec4dc14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[BUILD OUR MOVEMENT](https://substack.com/redirect/18b9187d-3606-418e-bfde-3e14aec4dc14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I've endured relentless attacks from Trump and his MAGA supporters. They've called me every name in the book. They've threatened my family. They've threatened me.
**But I still believe that we must stand up for what 's right.**
Now, Donald Trump is back in the White House with unchecked power.
His ICE agents are terrorizing communities with masks and military weapons -- just like his insurrectionists did on January 6th. The only difference is that now they're being paid with your tax dollars.
His MAGA enablers in Congress are letting him treat the Constitution like it's optional. They're ignoring subpoenas. They're refusing oversight. They're acting like Trump is a king instead of a president.
And I'm not going to sit back and let it happen.
That's why I'm running for Congress, friends. Because my oath to protect and defend the Constitution didn't end on January 6th. It will never end.
I'm ready to continue this fight in Congress. I know Trump and his MAGA machine inside and out. I've faced them before. I stood strong when it mattered most. **[So I'm asking directly: can you give $10, $25, or more before our End-of-Quarter deadline to help us protect the vote and stop Trump's power grab?](https://substack.com/redirect/18b9187d-3606-418e-bfde-3e14aec4dc14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[STOP TRUMP'S POWER GRAB](https://substack.com/redirect/18b9187d-3606-418e-bfde-3e14aec4dc14?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_Together, we 're going to prove that **Americans will stand up for what 's right.**_
Thank you for standing with me,
Harry Dunn
Democrat for Congress in Maryland's 5th District

subject: Washington Parish Republican Executive Committee Endorses Trump-Endorsed Congresswoman Julia Letlow for U.S. Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Julia Letlow for Louisiana
body:
Support continues to build across Louisiana as Republican leaders rally behind Letlow.

| | |

| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMarch 13, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**Washington Parish Republican Executive Committee Endorses Trump-Endorsed Congresswoman Julia Letlow for U.S. Senate** _Support continues to build across Louisiana as Republican leaders rally behind Letlow._
**BATON ROUGE, LA** \- Today, Congresswoman Julia Letlow, the Trump-endorsed candidate for U.S. Senate in Louisiana, announced she has received the endorsement of the Washington Parish Executive Committee.
The endorsement from the Washington Parish Republican Executive Committee marks another significant show of support for Rep. Letlow’s campaign, as grassroots Republicans across Louisiana continue to rally behind her conservative leadership and commitment to putting Louisiana families first.
_“I am incredibly grateful to have the support of the Washington Parish Republican Executive Committee,”_ **said Rep. Letlow.**_“Grassroots Republicans across Louisiana understand what’s at stake in this race, and I’m honored to have their trust as we work together to fight for our values and our future.”_
_“Congresswoman Julia Letlow has proven herself to be a principled conservative who understands the priorities of Louisiana families,”_**said Washington Parish Republican Executive Committee Chairman Brent Jones**. _“With the support of President Trump and growing support across the state, the Washington Parish Republican Executive Committee is proud to endorse her campaign for the United States Senate.”_
Rep. Letlow has built strong support across the state as she runs to bring conservative leadership to the United States Senate. She has been endorsed by President Donald Trump, Governor Jeff Landry, Louisiana Public Service Commissioner Eric Skrmetta, Jefferson Parish Republican Executive Committee, and numerous other state leaders.
For more information, visit [JuliaLetlow.com](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=b5a26d42be&e=95355a072c).

name: Doug Lindner, LCV
subject: TAKE ACTION: Defend Voting Rights from MAGA Attacks!
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM1NTMwMzcS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQyMTAzMzA4OQS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Tell Your Senator:
Protect Voting Rights, Reject the SAVE America Act!

Republicans are trying to pass a new version of the anti-voter SAVE Act— their latest attack on our voting rights. This “SAVE America Act” would be the
biggest federal rollback of voting rights in our country’s history, particularly
burdening 146 million Americans who don’t have a passport, millions who can’t
easily access a birth certificate, rural voters, voters of color, voters with
disabilities, survivors of climate disasters, and the tens of millions of people
— including 69 million married women — who have changed their names.

Tell your Senator: keep elections free and fair — stop the SAVE America Act! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~ ADD YOUR NAME https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/rNykfEpK0~ Peter, Every eligible voter, no matter their race, income, ability, or zip code, has
the right to choose their own leaders through free and fair elections.
Generations of civil rights activists put their lives on the line to secure
these rights, but now Donald Trump and Republicans in Congress are trying to rip
them away. If passed, the SAVE America Act would imperil the fundamental rights of millions
of voters across the country, roll back mail voting, cause legitimate voters’
ballots to be thrown out, and make voter registration harder for over 100
million eligible voters. We can’t let this happen. Tell your Senator: reject the SAVE America Act and protect free and fair elections! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/G8bxcKLX02h~ This bill would hurt communities across the country, including those already
suffering from exposure to toxic pollution and other environmental injustices.
It would particularly burden 146 million Americans who don’t have a passport,
millions who can’t easily access a birth certificate, rural voters, voters of
color, voters with disabilities, survivors of climate disasters, and the tens of
millions of people — including 69 million married women — who have changed their
names. Collective grassroots pressure from LCV members like you is essential. Together,
we must compel the Senate to reject this attack on our democracy and our ability
to choose our own leaders through free and fair elections — so we can all
continue advocating for the well-being of people and the planet. Add your name today and protect our voting rights! https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/j9y2f07gbWC_ Thank you for your commitment to supporting free and fair elections, and to the
safe, just, and equitable future we all deserve. Sincerely, Doug Lindner

subject: [Add Your Name] Will you join us and call for the immediate resignation of Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth?
body:
[1]LeftNet

Pete Hegseth has put American troops and civilians at risk, and he needs
to resign.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/sign/pete-hegseth-resignation/?source=em20260313-1525&t=1001&akid=1525%2E2118727%2EKPe-kb ]Add your name to our petition today to demand Pete Hegseth’s
resignation and demand accountability for his reckless actions as
Secretary of Defense →

Last year, Hegseth recklessly shared sensitive operational details about
U.S. strikes in Yemen over Signal on his personal phone, using an
unapproved channel for information that could have endangered service
members and compromised operations.

Now, an inquiry into the strike on a school in Iran, where at least 175
people, most of whom were children, died, indicates the United States was
likely responsible, with reports pointing to faulty or outdated targeting
data as a key factor.

Yet Hegseth and other officials have largely refused to explain what
happened, even as the President has floated blame elsewhere.

This is what a reckless leader who has no regard for human life looks
like. No transparency. No accountability. And no plan to prevent it from
happening again.

The job of Secretary of Defense is not to wing it or treat catastrophic
mistakes and the lives of innocent children like a PR problem. The
Department of Defense demands the highest standards, and Pete Hegseth has
failed to meet them. That’s why we are calling for his immediate
resignation.

[ https://act.leftnet.org/sign/pete-hegseth-resignation/?source=em20260313-1525&t=1002&akid=1525%2E2118727%2EKPe-kb ]If you agree that leaders who endanger people and evade accountability
have no business running the Department of Defense, add your name to
demand Pete Hegseth’s resignation.

Thank you,

— LeftNet

Friend,

Before you log off for the weekend, I wanted to send you a personal message. I know it’s a bit long, but I’d be so grateful if you took a couple of minutes to read it.

**For me, serving in the State Legislature or running for Congress isn’t about politics or power._It’s personal._**

Let me explain: I’m the proud daughter of two first-generation immigrants. My father worked as a mechanic, and my mother worked odd jobs while raising us. **Together, they taught me the values that still guide me today:_service, sacrifice, and standing up for what’s right._**

After medical school, I stayed here, determined to practice medicine in the community that raised me. As a physician, I’ve had a front row seat to the impact of policy that leaves people behind: veterans struggling with addiction, patients putting off preventative care, a lack of preparedness for crises like COVID-19, and more.

[I’m running to represent CA-22 because I’m tired of seeing my patients, neighbors, and community members left behind. Inside Elections, one of the most respected nonpartisan race trackers in the country, just shifted FOUR Republican-held House seats to Democrats.

NC-11 and TX-23 – districts where GOTV PAC has endorsed candidates, because we believe low-propensity voters in those communities can decide the outcome – have just been reclassified as genuinely competitive!

That's cost-effective, and it works!

body:
Plus: Trump says there's "practically nothing left to target" in Iran | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=12e657dedb&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | |
Two ISIS-inspired men threw IEDs packed with explosives at Americans in New York City. The NYPD called it terrorism. [CNN called them "Pennsylvania teenagers"](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=f3d446e862&e=567664f14c) enjoying "abnormally warm weather."

| |
🔥 **CNN CALLED ISIS TERRORISTS "PENNSYLVANIA TEENAGERS" — THEN DELETED IT**
The NYPD Commissioner held a press conference. Crystal clear: ISIS-inspired. Admitted it on camera. Admitted it in custody. No ambiguity whatsoever.
Then CNN tweeted about two teenagers from Pennsylvania who crossed into New York City "for what could have been a normal day." The backlash was immediate. They deleted the tweet. Then Abby Phillip went on air and said the bombs were aimed at the mayor — also wrong. She had to correct herself the next morning and blamed her producers.
**Mark lays out the full timeline. Layer after layer. This isn't incompetence — it's a pattern.**
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=0d115ca6ea&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
📊 **69% OF DEMOCRATS SAY AMERICA IS NOT A FORCE FOR GOOD**
A new poll breaks it down by party: 91% of Republicans say America is a force for good. 69% of Democrats say it's not. Independents split 50-50.
When nearly three-quarters of one party thinks their own country is bad — and you look at who's feeding them information — the connection is impossible to ignore.

🏛️ **HAALAND CRUSHES BREGMAN 73-27 — EXCLUSIVE POLLING COMING SUNDAY**
Haaland won the Democratic pre-primary convention with 73.5% of the delegate vote. Mark says the closest this primary will be is 15-20 points.
But here's the tease: Mark has been told exclusive polling data on the Democratic race is coming — at least one poll, possibly two. The big question: has the Epstein flight moved the needle at all? Tune in Sunday.

⚠️ **IRAN — "PRACTICALLY NOTHING LEFT TO TARGET"**
Trump told Axios the war is "way ahead of timetable" and there is "practically nothing left." Netanyahu is calling on Iranians to rise up. The new Ayatollah hasn't been seen.
Iran's one play left is disrupting oil markets — they're hitting tankers and mining the Strait. The US has destroyed 16 mine-laying vessels. Gas is up 60-80 cents. Mark thinks within a week, Trump or Netanyahu tells the Iranian people it's time.

Lately, I've been doing some reflecting on my grandfather, President John F. Kennedy, and his legacy of hope.
In my run to fight for NY-12 in Congress, and just as a person, that's what I want to focus on. Hope.
My name is Jack, or John Bouvier Kennedy Schlossberg if you want to know the whole thing.
In high school, I spent hours watching my grandfather's speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. When we fight for hope, we're not just doing it for ourselves, we're doing it for each other and the future we all have to share.
I know I have big shoes to fill. In my grandfather's memory, I've led a life of caring about this a lot. I put that care and effort and hope into everything I do.
But this is bigger than me. It's bigger than my family's legacy.
Hope is hard to find in Politics these days, but if we let it die out completely, that's how we really lose. Now cannot be the time to stop caring or turn away. We have to double down in our pursuit of hope.
I really think this election is the one — our last chance to stop Trump and change the direction we're heading in.
I need you to know that I believe we can do it. I believe in hope, and I believe in us. Will you believe with me?
